description: Refurbishment of the building to create retail use at lower ground and ground floor level, flexible retail / office use at first floor, office use at levels 2-6 and cycle and waste stores and end of trip facilities at lower ground floor, including removal of the building's primary facade and replacement with new curtain walling system and new shopfront at ground floor level; conversion of existing ground floor garage to create new retail floorspace, including removal of rolling garage door and replacement with new shopfront; alterations to Stafford Street elevation at level 1 and 2; refurbishment of existing glazed rear staircase compartment including removal of existing wired glazing and replacement with clear glass; creation of new external rear fire escape stair including removal of existing stair, infilling of floorplate between levels 3 and 6 to create additional floorspace and new external stair from ground to sixth floor; lateral extensions into the rear lightwell at level 1 and level 2 to create additional floorspace; creation of external roof terrace at third floor level, including creation of new single door access in rear elevation; internal alterations including removal of existing partitions, works of refurbishment and damp proofing at lower ground floor; replacement of services throughout and installation of plant equipment at sixth floor roof level; repairs to the existing concrete and brick elements of the building; and other associated works. (Linked with 25/08323/FULL)
